en.title: Email routing and first-reply drafting
en.pain: A shared mailbox someone reads every morning, sorting what is urgent from what is routine, and typing the same four answers.
en.changes: Mail is classified on arrival, routine replies are drafted for a human to send, and the rest is routed to the right person with context attached.

zh.title: 邮件分流与首轮回复起草
zh.pain: 一个每天早上有人挨条看的公共邮箱：分出哪些急、哪些是例行，然后把同样的四种回复再打一遍。
zh.changes: 邮件进来就分类，例行回复自动起草交人确认发出，其余的连同上下文一起转给对的人。

en.title: Bid and RFP response assembly
en.pain: Every bid is assembled by hand from previous bids nobody can find, and the deadline decides how much reuse actually happens.
en.changes: Requirements are extracted from the RFP, matched against past answers, and assembled into a first draft with the gaps marked for a human.

zh.title: 投标与 RFP 应答组装
zh.pain: 每份标书都是从「谁也找不到」的历史标书里手工拼出来的，最后能复用多少取决于还剩几天。
zh.changes: 从 RFP 里抽出条目、匹配历史答复、拼出初稿，缺口标出来留给人补。

en.title: Field service operations agent
en.pain: Dispatch, parts, history and the engineer's own notes live in four systems, and the person in the van has none of them.
en.changes: One agent answers across all four, in the field, and writes the visit back to the system of record.

zh.title: 现场服务运营 Agent
zh.pain: 派工、备件、历史工单和工程师自己的记录分在四个系统里，而车上那个人一个都打不开。
zh.changes: 一个 agent 横跨四个系统在现场作答，并把这次上门写回记录系统。

en.title: Invoice and order recognition
en.pain: Someone retypes numbers from a PDF into a form, and the errors surface a month later in a reconciliation.
en.changes: Fields are read off the document, checked against the order, and only the exceptions reach a person.

zh.title: 发票与订单识别
zh.pain: 有人把 PDF 上的数字重新敲进表单，错误一个月后在对账时才浮出来。
zh.changes: 字段直接从单据读出、与订单核对，只有异常才送到人手上。

en.title: Expense policy questions
en.pain: Finance answers the same twenty questions every month, and the policy document is long enough that nobody reads it first.
en.changes: An agent answers from the current policy, cites the clause, and escalates the genuinely ambiguous cases.

zh.title: 报销政策答疑
zh.pain: 财务每个月回答同样的二十个问题，而政策文档长到没人愿意先翻一遍。
zh.changes: Agent 依据现行政策作答并引用条款，真正模糊的情况再升级给人。

en.title: Month-end close chase-up
en.pain: Close depends on a dozen submissions arriving, and someone spends the last three days chasing the ones that have not.
en.changes: Outstanding items are tracked and chased automatically, with the status visible to everyone instead of living in one person's spreadsheet.

zh.title: 月结催办
zh.pain: 结账要等十几份材料齐，最后三天总有人在挨个催没交的那几份。
zh.changes: 未交项自动跟踪催办，状态对所有人可见，而不是躺在某一个人的表格里。

en.title: HR policy and benefits questions
en.pain: The same questions about leave, benefits and process arrive in HR's inbox all year, phrased differently every time.
en.changes: An agent answers from the current handbook and hands over to a person the moment the question becomes personal.

zh.title: HR 政策与福利答疑
zh.pain: 关于休假、福利、流程的同一批问题全年不断进 HR 邮箱，每次问法还不一样。
zh.changes: Agent 依据现行手册作答；一旦问题涉及个人情况，立刻转人。

en.title: New-joiner onboarding runbook
en.pain: Onboarding is a checklist in someone's head, spread across HR, IT and the hiring manager, and every new joiner gets a slightly different version.
en.changes: One tracked runbook that opens the right tickets, nudges the right people, and shows the new joiner where they are.

zh.title: 新人入职流程
zh.pain: 入职是存在某个人脑子里的清单，横跨 HR、IT 和用人经理，每个新人拿到的版本都略有不同。
zh.changes: 一份被跟踪的流程：自动开对应工单、提醒对应的人，新人自己也看得到进度。

en.title: Job description drafting and CV first pass
en.pain: Every role is written from scratch, and the first CV pass is a volume problem that pushes real judgement to the end.
en.changes: Drafts come from roles you have already written; the first pass surfaces evidence against the criteria rather than a score.

zh.title: JD 起草与简历初筛
zh.pain: 每个岗位都从零写起；简历初筛是个量的问题，把真正需要判断的部分挤到了最后。
zh.changes: JD 从你写过的岗位里生成；初筛给出对照标准的证据，而不是一个分数。

en.title: IT helpdesk first line
en.pain: A large share of tickets are password, access and how-do-I questions that a knowledge base already answers.
en.changes: The agent resolves what the knowledge base covers, and everything else reaches a human already triaged.

zh.title: IT 服务台一线
zh.pain: 相当大一部分工单是密码、权限和「这个怎么弄」，而知识库里本来就有答案。
zh.changes: 知识库覆盖得到的由 agent 直接解决，其余的到人手上时已经分好类。

en.title: Access request handling
en.pain: Access requests arrive as free text, need an approver nobody can name, and stall for days at the wrong desk.
en.changes: The request is structured on arrival, the approver is resolved from the system, and the wait becomes visible.

zh.title: 权限申请处理
zh.pain: 权限申请以大白话提交，需要一个谁也说不清是谁的审批人，然后在错的人那里卡好几天。
zh.changes: 申请进来就结构化，审批人从系统里解析出来，等待时间变得可见。

en.title: Agent over a legacy business system
en.pain: A system everyone depends on and nobody wants to change, reachable only by people who know its screens.
en.changes: An agent fronts it for the common tasks, so the system stays put while the people around it stop having to learn it.

zh.title: 老业务系统前置 Agent
zh.pain: 一个所有人都依赖、但谁也不想动的系统，只有熟悉它界面的人才用得了。
zh.changes: 常见操作由 agent 代劳：系统原地不动，但周围的人不必再去学它。

en.title: Document review against rules
en.pain: Contracts, specs or submissions are checked by hand against a set of rules that lives partly in a document and partly in an expert's memory.
en.changes: Every clause is checked against the stated rules, with the evidence quoted, so the reviewer argues with findings instead of reading from scratch.

zh.title: 按规则做文档审查
zh.pain: 合同、规格书或申报材料靠人工比对一套规则，而这套规则一半在文档里、一半在专家脑子里。
zh.changes: 每一条都对照明示的规则检查并给出原文证据，审查者从「重头读」变成「跟结论较真」。

en.title: Meeting notes to tracked actions
en.pain: Decisions and owners are agreed in the room and then live in someone's notebook until the next meeting rediscovers them.
en.changes: Actions and owners are extracted and land in the tracker the team already uses.

zh.title: 会议纪要转可跟踪行动项
zh.pain: 决定和负责人在会上说定了，然后躺在某人的笔记本里，直到下次开会重新发现一遍。
zh.changes: 行动项和负责人被抽出来，落进团队本来就在用的跟踪工具。

en.title: Ask across your own documents
en.pain: The answer exists, in a file, in a site nobody remembers the name of, written by someone who has left.
en.changes: One place to ask, answering only from your own documents, with the source shown so the answer can be checked.

zh.title: 对着自己的文档提问
zh.pain: 答案是有的——在某个文件里，在某个没人记得名字的站点上，作者已经离职了。
zh.changes: 一个统一入口提问，只依据你自己的文档作答，并给出出处以便核对。

en.title: Chasing late purchase orders
en.pain: A buyer works down a list of overdue lines, emails suppliers one at a time, and pastes whatever comes back into the same spreadsheet.
en.changes: Overdue lines are chased on a schedule, replies are read for a committed date, and only a dispute or a silence reaches the buyer.

zh.title: 催逾期采购订单
zh.pain: 采购员对着一张逾期清单，一家一家发邮件催，再把回复一条条粘回同一张表里。
zh.changes: 逾期行按节奏自动催，回复里读出承诺交期，只有扯皮或没人理才转到采购员手上。

en.title: Packing list against purchase order
en.pain: Packing lists arrive as scans and phone photos, and someone compares them line by line against the order before anything can be booked in.
en.changes: Lines are read off the document and matched to the order; only quantity and part-number mismatches are raised for a person to settle.

zh.title: 送货单与采购订单核对
zh.pain: 送货单是扫描件和手机照片，入库之前得有人逐行和订单比对。
zh.changes: 从单据上读出行项并与订单匹配，只有数量或料号对不上才提给人处理。

en.title: Supplier documents and expiry tracking
en.pain: Certificates, insurance and bank details are collected over email, and nobody can say which supplier is missing what until an audit asks.
en.changes: Required documents are tracked per supplier, expiry dates are read off the certificates, and the chaser goes out before one lapses.

zh.title: 供应商资质与到期跟踪
zh.pain: 资质、保险、银行信息都是邮件来回收的，哪家缺什么，得等审计问起来才知道。
zh.changes: 按供应商跟踪应交材料，从证书上读出有效期，在过期之前就把催办发出去。

en.title: Answering “where is my order”
en.pain: Sales and the plants ask the same question all day, and a planner looks it up across two systems and a spreadsheet to answer it.
en.changes: Status questions are answered from the systems of record with the source shown, and a planner is pulled in only when the date has actually slipped.

zh.title: 回答「我的货到哪了」
zh.pain: 销售和工厂一天到晚问同一个问题，计划员每次都要跨两个系统加一张表去查。
zh.changes: 直接依据系统里的记录作答并给出出处，只有交期真的滑了才叫计划员介入。
